item.title: Agent Anomaly Detection: Safeguarding agents across other clouds
item.description: Agent Anomaly Detection now monitors ADK agents running across AWS, Azure, or on-premises by analyzing their traces and logs in your Google Cloud project By ingesting OpenTelemetry-formatted data through the Telemetry API, it evaluates full conversations for behavioral drift without needing access to the agent's underlying runtime This enables security teams to detect risks like rogue behaviors, tool misuse, and resource exhaustion across multi-cloud environments.
